candidates.source_title: a boy who raised as a girl 🫠
candidates.source_description:
Philippe I, Duke of Orléans, was the younger brother of Louis XIV and the son of Anne of Austria.

Historical accounts describe Philippe as deeply interested in feminine fashion, makeup, jewelry, perfumes, and extravagant clothing. He was also known for his relationships with male favorites.
